metadata.title: Ramen Operator Resource Catalog
metadata.description: Comprehensive catalog of all Kubernetes/OpenShift resources created by the Ramen DR operator

resources.name: ManifestWork (VRG)
resources.creator: DRPlacementControlReconciler
resources.purpose: Wraps VolumeReplicationGroup for deployment on managed clusters via OCM
resources.notes: Name format: {drpc-name}-{drpc-namespace}-vrg-mw

resources.name: ManifestWork (Namespace)
resources.creator: DRPlacementControlReconciler
resources.purpose: Wraps Namespace resource for creation on managed clusters; uses Orphan delete policy
resources.notes: Name format: {drpc-name}-{namespace}-ns-mw. Delete policy is Orphan to preserve namespace.

resources.name: ManifestWork (Recipe)
resources.creator: DRPlacementControlReconciler
resources.purpose: Wraps Recipe resource for kube object protection workflow on managed clusters
resources.notes: Name format: {drpc-name}-{drpc-namespace}-recipe-mw. Delete policy is Orphan.

resources.name: ManifestWork (DRClusterConfig)
resources.creator: DRClusterReconciler
resources.purpose: Wraps DRClusterConfig for detecting storage/replication classes on managed clusters

resources.name: ManifestWork (NetworkFence)
resources.creator: DRClusterReconciler
resources.purpose: Wraps NetworkFence for network isolation during MetroDR failover on managed clusters
resources.notes: Name format: {cluster-name}-{cluster-namespace}-nf-mw

resources.name: ManifestWork (MaintenanceMode)
resources.creator: DRClusterReconciler
resources.purpose: Wraps MaintenanceMode to notify storage backends of failover actions on managed clusters

resources.name: ManifestWork (DR-Cluster Operator Deploy)
resources.creator: DRClusterReconciler
resources.purpose: Wraps Namespace, ClusterRole, OperatorGroup, ConfigMap, and Subscription for automated dr-cluster operator deployment
resources.notes: Only created when DeploymentAutomationEnabled is true. Contains multiple wrapped resources.

resources.name: ManagedClusterView
resources.creator: DRPlacementControlReconciler
resources.purpose: Queries status of VRG, Namespace, and other resources on managed clusters via OCM
resources.notes: Used for VRG status, Namespace status, StorageClass, VolumeSnapshotClass, VolumeGroupSnapshotClass, NetworkFenceClass, DRClusterConfig views

resources.name: ManagedClusterAddOn (VolSync)
resources.creator: DRClusterReconciler
resources.purpose: Deploys VolSync operator to managed clusters via ACM addon framework
resources.notes: Named 'volsync'. Created in the managed cluster's namespace on the hub.

resources.name: Policy (Secret Propagation)
resources.creator: SecretPropagator (DRPolicyReconciler)
resources.purpose: Propagates S3/Velero secrets to managed clusters via OCM governance policy with embedded ConfigurationPolicy
resources.notes: Contains an embedded ConfigurationPolicy that ensures the Secret exists on target clusters

resources.name: PlacementBinding (Secret Propagation)
resources.creator: SecretPropagator (DRPolicyReconciler)
resources.purpose: Binds secret propagation Policy to PlacementRule for targeting managed clusters

resources.name: PlacementRule (Secret Propagation)
resources.creator: SecretPropagator (DRPolicyReconciler)
resources.purpose: Targets managed clusters for secret propagation via governance policy

resources.name: PlacementDecision
resources.creator: DRPlacementControlReconciler
resources.purpose: Records cluster placement decisions for DR-protected workloads
resources.notes: Updated with status sub-resource for target cluster selection

resources.name: ConfigMap (RamenConfig)
resources.creator: DRClusterReconciler
resources.purpose: Stores Ramen operator configuration for the dr-cluster operator, delivered via ManifestWork
resources.notes: Named ramen-dr-cluster-operator-config. Wrapped inside the DR-Cluster deploy ManifestWork.

resources.name: Namespace (Operator Deploy)
resources.creator: DRClusterReconciler
resources.purpose: Creates namespace for dr-cluster operator on managed clusters via ManifestWork
resources.notes: Created when DeploymentAutomationEnabled is true. Also creates ops namespace if configured.

resources.name: Namespace (Protected App)
resources.creator: DRPlacementControlReconciler
resources.purpose: Creates/ensures protected application namespaces on managed clusters via ManifestWork
resources.notes: Supports multi-namespace protection. Orphan policy ensures namespace survives ManifestWork deletion.

resources.name: ClusterRole (OLM Edit)
resources.creator: DRClusterReconciler
resources.purpose: Grants klusterlet work agent permission to manage OLM OperatorGroups on managed clusters
resources.notes: Named open-cluster-management:klusterlet-work-sa:agent:olm-edit. Only when DeploymentAutomationEnabled.

resources.name: ClusterRole (VRG Edit)
resources.creator: DRPlacementControlReconciler
resources.purpose: Grants klusterlet work agent permission to manage VolumeReplicationGroup resources
resources.notes: Named open-cluster-management:klusterlet-work-sa:agent:volrepgroup-edit

resources.name: ClusterRole (MaintenanceMode Edit)
resources.creator: DRClusterReconciler
resources.purpose: Grants klusterlet work agent permission to manage MaintenanceMode resources
resources.notes: Named open-cluster-management:klusterlet-work-sa:agent:mmode-edit

resources.name: ClusterRole (DRClusterConfig Edit)
resources.creator: DRClusterReconciler
resources.purpose: Grants klusterlet work agent permission to manage DRClusterConfig resources
resources.notes: Named open-cluster-management:klusterlet-work-sa:agent:drclusterconfig-edit

resources.name: ClusterRole (NetworkFence Edit)
resources.creator: DRClusterReconciler
resources.purpose: Grants klusterlet work agent permission to manage NetworkFence resources
resources.notes: Named open-cluster-management:klusterlet-work-sa:agent:networkfence-edit

resources.name: ClusterRole (Recipe Edit)
resources.creator: DRPlacementControlReconciler
resources.purpose: Grants klusterlet work agent permission to manage Recipe resources
resources.notes: Named open-cluster-management:klusterlet-work-sa:agent:recipe-edit

resources.name: OperatorGroup
resources.creator: DRClusterReconciler
resources.purpose: Creates OperatorGroup for dr-cluster operator installation on managed clusters
resources.notes: Named ramen-operator-group. Only when DeploymentAutomationEnabled.

resources.name: Subscription
resources.creator: DRClusterReconciler
resources.purpose: Subscribes to dr-cluster operator package via OLM on managed clusters
resources.notes: Named ramen-dr-cluster-subscription. Only when DeploymentAutomationEnabled.

resources.name: VolumeReplicationGroup
resources.creator: DRPlacementControlReconciler
resources.purpose: Primary resource for managing volume replication and protection on managed clusters
resources.notes: Delivered to managed clusters via VRG ManifestWork. Reconciled by VRGReconciler on dr-cluster.

resources.name: DRClusterConfig
resources.creator: DRClusterReconciler
resources.purpose: Detects storage classes, replication classes, snapshot classes, and network fence classes on managed clusters
resources.notes: Reconciled by DRClusterConfigReconciler on the managed cluster side.

resources.name: MaintenanceMode
resources.creator: DRClusterReconciler
resources.purpose: Notifies storage backends to enter maintenance mode during failover operations
resources.notes: One per storage backend (identified by storageProvisioner + storageID)

resources.name: NetworkFence
resources.creator: DRClusterReconciler
resources.purpose: Performs network isolation/fencing of a cluster during MetroDR failover
resources.notes: Created for each NetworkFenceClass. Used in Metro DR scenarios.

resources.name: Recipe
resources.creator: DRPlacementControlReconciler
resources.purpose: Defines ordered workflow for capturing and recovering kube objects during DR operations
resources.notes: External type from github.com/ramendr/recipe. Copied from hub to managed cluster.

resources.name: VolumeReplication
resources.creator: VRGReconciler
resources.purpose: Manages per-PVC volume replication via CSI replication driver
resources.notes: One per PVC protected by VRG using VolumeReplication method

resources.name: VolumeGroupReplication
resources.creator: VRGReconciler
resources.purpose: Manages group-level volume replication for multiple PVCs as a consistency group
resources.notes: Groups PVCs by VolumeGroupReplicationClass for consistent replication

resources.name: ReplicationSource
resources.creator: VSHandler (VRGReconciler)
resources.purpose: Configures VolSync to replicate PVC data from source cluster to destination
resources.notes: One per PVC protected via VolSync. Supports rsync-tls and rclone copy methods.

resources.name: ReplicationDestination
resources.creator: VSHandler (VRGReconciler)
resources.purpose: Configures VolSync to receive replicated PVC data on destination cluster
resources.notes: One per PVC on the secondary/destination cluster.

resources.name: ReplicationGroupSource
resources.creator: CGHandler (VRGReconciler)
resources.purpose: Manages CephFS consistency group snapshots on source cluster for coordinated replication
resources.notes: Triggers VolumeGroupSnapshot creation for CephFS volumes

resources.name: ReplicationGroupDestination
resources.creator: CGHandler (VRGReconciler)
resources.purpose: Manages CephFS consistency group snapshot restoration on destination cluster

resources.name: VolumeSnapshot
resources.creator: VSHandler / VRGReconciler
resources.purpose: Creates point-in-time snapshots of PVCs for backup, restore, and VolSync operations
resources.notes: Used for final sync snapshots, dry-run snapshots, and restore operations

resources.name: VolumeGroupSnapshot
resources.creator: VolumeGroupSourceHandler (VRGReconciler)
resources.purpose: Creates coordinated group snapshots of multiple CephFS PVCs for consistency group replication
resources.notes: Triggers creation of individual VolumeSnapshots for each PVC in the group

resources.name: Secret (VolSync PSK)
resources.creator: VSHandler (VRGReconciler)
resources.purpose: Stores pre-shared key (PSK) for VolSync rsync-tls authentication between source and destination
resources.notes: Generated with random PSK data. Propagated to peer clusters via OCM Policy.

resources.name: Secret (Copied for VolSync)
resources.creator: VSHandler (VRGReconciler)
resources.purpose: Copies existing secrets into the protected namespace for VolSync replication use

resources.name: PersistentVolumeClaim (VolSync Destination)
resources.creator: VSHandler (VRGReconciler)
resources.purpose: Creates destination PVCs for VolSync replication and temporary PVCs for final sync
resources.notes: Also creates temporary PVCs for mount jobs and restore operations

resources.name: PersistentVolumeClaim (CephFS CG Restore)
resources.creator: VolumeGroupSourceHandler (VRGReconciler)
resources.purpose: Creates PVCs from VolumeSnapshot sources during CephFS consistency group restore

resources.name: Job (Mount for VolSync)
resources.creator: VSHandler (VRGReconciler)
resources.purpose: Mounts unmounted PVCs so VolSync ReplicationSource can access and replicate the data
resources.notes: Created when a PVC is not mounted by any pod but needs to be replicated by VolSync

resources.name: ServiceExport
resources.creator: VSHandler (VRGReconciler)
resources.purpose: Exports VolSync ReplicationDestination service for cross-cluster access via Submariner
resources.notes: Enables Submariner service discovery for rsync-tls endpoints between clusters

resources.name: Backup (Velero)
resources.creator: VRGReconciler (KubeObjectProtection)
resources.purpose: Captures Kubernetes objects (Deployments, ConfigMaps, etc.) to S3 for DR protection
resources.notes: Works with Recipe to define capture groups and ordering

resources.name: Restore (Velero)
resources.creator: VRGReconciler (KubeObjectProtection)
resources.purpose: Restores Kubernetes objects from S3 backup during DR recovery
resources.notes: Works with Recipe to define recovery groups and ordering

resources.name: BackupStorageLocation (Velero)
resources.creator: VRGReconciler (KubeObjectProtection)
resources.purpose: Configures S3-compatible object storage for Velero backup/restore operations
resources.notes: Points to S3 bucket configured in RamenConfig S3 profiles

resources.name: Event
resources.creator: Multiple controllers
resources.purpose: Records status events for debugging and monitoring of DR operations
resources.notes: Standard Kubernetes events attached to VRG, DRPC, and other resources

resources.name: Secret (Propagated to Managed Cluster)
resources.creator: OCM Policy Engine
resources.purpose: S3 credentials and Velero secrets propagated to managed clusters via OCM ConfigurationPolicy
resources.notes: Created by OCM governance engine when it enforces the ConfigurationPolicy on managed clusters

resources.name: ConfigurationPolicy (Embedded in Policy)
resources.creator: SecretPropagator (DRPolicyReconciler)
resources.purpose: Embedded within Policy to enforce Secret existence on managed clusters
resources.notes: Not a standalone resource on the hub; extracted by OCM policy framework on managed clusters

resources.name: VolSync-created VolumeSnapshot
resources.creator: VolSync Operator
resources.purpose: VolSync creates VolumeSnapshots as part of ReplicationSource/Destination sync cycles
resources.notes: Created and managed by VolSync operator during replication sync operations

resources.name: VolSync-created PersistentVolumeClaim
resources.creator: VolSync Operator
resources.purpose: VolSync creates temporary PVCs for staging data during replication sync
resources.notes: Intermediate PVCs used by VolSync for snapshot-based data movement

resources.name: VolSync-created Job/Pod
resources.creator: VolSync Operator
resources.purpose: VolSync creates Jobs/Pods to perform rsync-tls data transfer between clusters
resources.notes: Transfer pods that run rsync-tls or rclone to move data

resources.name: VolSync-created Service
resources.creator: VolSync Operator
resources.purpose: VolSync creates Services to expose rsync-tls endpoints for ReplicationDestination
resources.notes: Service endpoint used by ReplicationSource on peer cluster to connect

resources.name: Velero-created Pod
resources.creator: Velero Operator
resources.purpose: Velero creates Pods to execute backup and restore operations

resources.name: CSI Driver VolumeReplication (internal)
resources.creator: CSI Replication Driver
resources.purpose: CSI driver acts on VolumeReplication CR to configure storage-level replication
resources.notes: The CSI replication sidecar processes VolumeReplication CRs and configures storage backend replication

resources.name: VolumeGroupSnapshot-created VolumeSnapshots
resources.creator: CSI Snapshot Controller
resources.purpose: Individual VolumeSnapshots created by the snapshot controller when a VolumeGroupSnapshot is processed
resources.notes: One VolumeSnapshot per PVC in the group. Created by the CSI group snapshot controller.

resources.name: VolumeSnapshotContent
resources.creator: CSI Snapshot Controller
resources.purpose: Backing storage-level snapshot content created when a VolumeSnapshot is provisioned
resources.notes: Cluster-scoped resource binding a VolumeSnapshot to actual storage snapshot

resources.name: VolumeGroupSnapshotContent
resources.creator: CSI Snapshot Controller
resources.purpose: Backing storage-level group snapshot content created when a VolumeGroupSnapshot is provisioned
resources.notes: Cluster-scoped resource binding a VolumeGroupSnapshot to actual storage group snapshot

resources.name: OLM-created Deployment (dr-cluster operator)
resources.creator: OLM
resources.purpose: OLM creates the dr-cluster operator Deployment after processing the Subscription
resources.notes: Only when DeploymentAutomationEnabled. OLM installs the CSV and creates the operator Deployment.

resources.name: OLM-created ClusterServiceVersion
resources.creator: OLM
resources.purpose: OLM creates CSV representing the installed dr-cluster operator version
resources.notes: Only when DeploymentAutomationEnabled.

resources.name: OLM-created InstallPlan
resources.creator: OLM
resources.purpose: OLM creates InstallPlan to track dr-cluster operator installation steps
resources.notes: Only when DeploymentAutomationEnabled.
